entities.summary:
Vaporwave is a microgenre of electronic music, Internet aesthetic and meme that emerged in the late 2000s and early 2010s. It is defined partly by its slowed-down, chopped and screwed samples of smooth jazz, elevator music, R&B, and lounge music from the 1980s and 1990s. The surrounding subculture is sometimes associated with an ambiguous or satirical take on consumer capitalism and pop culture, and tends to be characterized by a nostalgic or surrealist engagement with the popular entertainment, digital technology and advertising of previous decades.

vaporwave is a music genre, created circa 2009. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
